def test_largest_smallest_integers():
    # only positives -> no negative
    assert largest_smallest_integers([2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 7]) == (None, 1)
    # only negatives -> no positive
    assert largest_smallest_integers([-4, -2, -1, -5]) == (-1, None)
    # mixed
    assert largest_smallest_integers([1, -1, 2, -2]) == (-1, 1)
    assert largest_smallest_integers([-10, 10, 0, -5, 5, -1, 1]) == (-1, 1)
    # 0 is neither < 0 nor > 0
    assert largest_smallest_integers([0, -1, 1]) == (-1, 1)
    assert largest_smallest_integers([0, 0, 0]) == (None, None)
    # empty
    assert largest_smallest_integers([]) == (None, None)
    # single element
    assert largest_smallest_integers([-5]) == (-5, None)
    assert largest_smallest_integers([5]) == (None, 5)
